nodes.author: andrew
nodes.statement: Give the particle field and scroll-collapse morph the same perceptual contrast in light/default mode as in dark. Use ink-black points at full opacity (SceneField opacity 1, size 2.9) and a high-alpha near-black additive base (ParticleReveal restA 0.60, base 0.05).
nodes.rationale: Light is the default surface, so the signature moment cannot be a dark-mode-only feature.
alternatives_rejected: Deliberately subdued light-mode field (old restA 0.26 / base 0.14 — read as barely-there)
Raising dark mode down to meet light instead

nodes.author: andrew
nodes.statement: Never clip atmospheric orbs or place them directly behind text. Separate text with distorted glass or a dark scrim; any orb bleeding toward text must use blur(80px)+ and huge low-alpha radials so it only barely touches.
nodes.rationale: Andrew corrected the generated atmosphere page because its colored orbs were cut off and placed directly behind text without glass to distort them.
alternatives_rejected: Orbs cut off at section edges by overflow:hidden
Orbs painted directly behind body text at readable intensity

nodes.author: andrew
nodes.statement: Set display-serif line-height to at least 120%; reject compressed headline leading.
nodes.rationale: Andrew said the line height should be at least 120% and that the design judge should catch violations.
alternatives_rejected: tight editorial headline stacking on this surface

nodes.author: andrew
nodes.statement: Treat collapsed overlay panels as fully paused: leave the page normally clickable and navigable, and enable grab selection only when the user deliberately expands a panel.
nodes.rationale: Hijacking clicks while the tool is out of view is infuriating when the user is simply navigating their own site.
alternatives_rejected: Cold-open arming where the first page click selects an element and reveals the panel

nodes.author: andrew
nodes.statement: Do not place cards inside cards in panel UIs. Keep content groups flat and distinguish them with hairlines and group labels instead of nested raised rounded containers.
nodes.rationale: Nested cards create card-soup; the panel already supplies the container, so hairline rules and labels should carry the grouping.
alternatives_rejected: Raised rounded bordered card per section/category nested inside the panel card

nodes.author: andrew
nodes.statement: Restrict orange (#FFAB40) to code and terminal output, including code strings and semantic warning severities. Use blue (#00BFFF) for all page chrome, including kicker indices, step numbers, and required badges.
alternatives_rejected: orange promoted as a general chrome/signal accent across kickers, step numbers, and badges
